card.title: The Same Ending
card.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You ended your message with 'take care.' That's how my last breakup started.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said you had a cold. I meant get better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He wanted me healthy before he left too. Less guilt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So we're at the final kindness. Will it be in a container you don't need back?

mechanism: A assimilates both neutral wording and caring help into a single feared breakup pattern.
confusable: Unlike general anxiety, every new detail must point to the same ending and change A's interpretation of B.
comparison: Illness and soup turn kindness into predicted departure; the other scene transforms rescheduled lunch into a public breakup.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
